evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: At the dataset level, grid-searching the optimal relevance-diversity weight per benchmark reveals substantial cross-task variation.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We first derive a Geometric Intent Prior (GIP) from the spatial concentration of text-relevant tokens to infer a sample-specific relevance-diversity weight, and then apply this weight to jointly select tokens via a Weighted Text Centroid (WTC) for relevance scoring and a Visual Marginal Coverage Gain (VMCG) for diversity.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAVER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks, retaining 96.5% of full-model performance on LLaVA-1.5-7B with only 11.1% of the original visual tokens, and further generalizing to LLaVA-NeXT and Mini-Gemini.
